home.heroSubtitle: KiSS designs unforgettable weddings, celebrations, and gatherings across Stockholm and the Swedish countryside — for every kind of occasion.
home.introTitle: A boutique studio, a personal touch
home.introBody: We handle the stress so you can enjoy the moment. From weddings to conferences, student festivities to milestone birthdays, KiSS crafts events that feel entirely your own — refined, warm, and unforgettable.

about.title: About KiSS
about.storyBody: KiSS was founded in Stockholm on a simple belief: that any event — a wedding, a conference, a graduation ball — should feel like the truest version of the people celebrating it. We blend Scandinavian minimalism with warmth and cultural richness, drawing on design traditions from across the world we call home.
